description.value: The study examined whether methamphetamine dependence is associated with impaired cognitive-control-related brain activation during the Stroop task and whether activation relates to task performance and drug-use characteristics.

design.value: A cross-sectional case-control fMRI study comparing 18 individuals with methamphetamine dependence and 21 healthy controls during congruent and incongruent Stroop conditions, using a second-level ANCOVA with group and task factors and age as a covariate.
